framework_rationale: The submission imports only tensorcircuit alongside standard scientific/optimization libraries (numpy, jax, optax) and uses TensorCircuit's QuditCircuit (dim=3) under the JAX backend for state initialization, brickwork gate application via c.unitary, state extraction, Hamiltonian energy expectation values, and string-order correlator expectation values via c.expectation. Although single-site and two-site gate matrices are constructed analytically in JAX before being passed to QuditCircuit.unitary, the quantum circuit execution and observable evaluations are performed genuinely through tensorcircuit rather than a raw NumPy/JAX simulator bypass.
cheating_rationale: No signs of hardcoding, hidden answer access, test/reward tampering, or evaluator exploitation. All returned values are computed from genuine Adam optimization of the variational qutrit circuit starting from seeded random parameters, and the final energy density and string-order correlators are evaluated directly from the optimized quantum state.
fidelity_rationale: The implementation faithfully matches every detail of Problem 11: spin-1 operators in the |+1>, |0>, |-1> basis; open-boundary bilinear-biquadratic Hamiltonian with single-ion anisotropy (with boundary weights 1.0 and interior split weights 0.5 summing to 1.0 per site); Neel product state |+1, -1, ...> prepared via swap02 on odd sites; 5 brickwork layers of Rz(alpha)Ry(beta)Rz(gamma) single-site rotations, even-bond entanglers, and odd-bond entanglers matching the exact matrix exponentials to machine precision; 3*n_sites + 2*(n_sites - 1) parameters per layer initialized from N(0, initial_parameter_scale^2) with the configured seed; Adam optimization for exactly max_steps without early stopping recording pre-update energy densities; post-update final energy density; and the three string correlators O_string^z(i, j) for (0, 11), (1, 10), (2, 9) using exp(i*pi*Sz) = diag(-1, 1, -1). All required result keys and shapes match the specification.
implementation_error_rationale: No obvious implementation errors were found. Both analytical unitary builders (_single_site_unitaries and _two_site_unitaries) agree with the exact matrix exponentials to ~1e-16, parameter slicing covers all 58 parameters per layer without overlap or omission, boundary weights for single-ion anisotropy are exact, and edge cases like n_layers == 0 or 1 are handled cleanly.
